overview: PedalPost is an eco-friendly parcel delivery platform connecting customers and riders (bicycles and electric vehicles only). Features include real-time order tracking, photo proof of delivery, rider leaderboards, referral rewards, promo codes, and Stripe payment processing — all in South African Rands.
features: Stripe payment charging on rider acceptance
Card retry with order locked to same rider
Live order tracking map with rider location
Email notifications for all order events
